artworks.label: Ivory Brass Comet
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for velvet-observatory. One luxurious miniature celestial sculpture of a comet: a small irregular ivory pearl-stone comet nucleus at upper right, followed diagonally toward lower left by five elegant long curved antique-brass filaments that fan into a tapered flowing tail. The brass has fine engraved organic fluting and subtle patina; a single narrow deep-burgundy velvet ribbon is woven gently through the middle of the tail as an inset material accent. Restrained antique observatory aesthetic, photorealistic still-life material detail, warm selective light, ivory/old brass/deep wine palette. Fully visible compact sculptural object, not a telescope, moth, orrery or crescent; no base, fabric backdrop or ornamental frame. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
